evidence: The ALD MSe2 (M = Fe, Co, Ni) films were first examined by transmission electron microscopy (TEM) for film crystallinity and microstructure. X-ray diffraction (XRD) and Raman spectroscopy were also employed to analyze the film crystallinity. The purity of the ALD MSe2 (M = Fe, Co, Ni) films was evaluated by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). The surface morphology of the ALD MSe2 films was evaluated by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and atomic force microscopy (AFM). The film thicknesses were measured by first scratching the ALD MSe2 (M = Fe, Co, Ni) films and then measuring the step profiles (Bruker, Dektak XT) across the scratched lines. The Se/M atomic ratios were measured by X-ray fluorescence (XRF).
